brief.text: Fleetwood Town have knocked Arsenal out of the Carabao Cup in the fourth round, drawing 1-1 and then winning 5-3 on penalties, and the BBC is already asking where it ranks among the great cup upsets. It got messier too: Max Dowman was sent off, Arteta said he was left "sad" and explained Dowman's outburst after the red card, three Arsenal stars are now on the injury list, and the match was stopped for eight minutes because of a drone. Arteta gambled with nine selection calls for this one, and with football.london calling it a £1.15 billion humiliation, the debate over whether he went too far won't go away quickly. There are no transfer rumours to rate today, so the only distraction on offer is Jamie Carragher weighing up Arsenal's chances of winning the Champions League.
